checks.claim: The refrigerant R-134a boils at about minus 26 degrees Celsius at normal air pressure
checks.why: Two property tables give -26.3 °C and -14.9 °F (about -26.1 °C) at 1 atm.

checks.claim: Food safety agencies say a fridge should be at 4 degrees Celsius (40 F) or colder
checks.why: The FDA says to keep the refrigerator at or below 40 °F (4 °C).

sources.title: FDA: Refrigerator Thermometers - Cold Facts about Food Safety

checks.claim: A fridge does not make cold; it moves heat from inside the box to the coils outside
checks.why: Sears and the LibreTexts HVAC course both say the heat taken from inside is released to the room at the condenser coils.

sources.title: How Does a Refrigerator Work? (Sears Home Services)
